response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack web developer with strong TypeScript/Node.js and some systems-level exposure (DLang, C/C++ at National Instruments), but he does not meet the core requirements of this role: there is no evidence of native-level Japanese proficiency, no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, no embedded networking or LAN-switch background, and no security-technology experience (MACsec, 802.1X, encryption, tamper detection). His C experience is limited and dated, making him a poor fit for a C-based embedded security firmware position.
strengths: Long, varied software career (15+ years) with strong general engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Some low-level/systems experience: C/C++ components at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, Linux familiarity
Fluent English and demonstrated ability to learn diverse stacks and tools
concerns: No indication of Japanese language ability, a hard requirement (native-level)
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
C for UNIX and Linux kernel modification experience is absent or minimal and dated (2014–2015)
